## Introduction

This is a Quarto presentation format that is consistent with The University of Birmingham's [brand](https://brand.birmingham.ac.uk/), especially its [colours](https://brand.birmingham.ac.uk/en/brand-guidelines/design-elements/#315) and [typography](https://brand.birmingham.ac.uk/en/brand-guidelines/design-elements/#1149).

:::{.notes}
Speaker notes go here.
:::

## Text highlights

Hightlight key words with a `.{color}` class, where `color` is one of: 

- [Gold]{.Gold}
- [Orange]{.Orange}
- [Green]{.Green}
- [Blue]{.Blue}
- [Yellow]{.Yellow}

## Additional colours

There's a colour for inline code such as `x <- c(1, 3, 6)` and `{.Gold-bg}`.

There's also a colour for short [links](https://github.com/cstawitz/uobpres) and full ones like <https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/>.

## Typography

The University of Birmingham brand font is **Larken**, which is available as part of Adobe Creative Suite.

The preferred font for body copy is **Manrope**, which is available open source.

Neither of these are freely available for use with Quarto.

This format therefore uses Warwick's final approved substitute font: **Arial**.

## Code

The extension includes a custom syntax highlighting theme:

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
library(dplyr)

penguins %>%
  mutate(
    long_flipper = case_when(
      species == "Adelie" & flipper_len > 195 ~ TRUE,
      species == "Chinstrap" & flipper_len > 200 ~ TRUE,
      species == "Gentoo" & flipper_len > 225 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    body_mass_kg = body_mass / 1000,
    bill_len_cm = bill_len / 10,
    bill_dep_cm = bill_dep / 10
  )
```

## Columns with backgrounds

Use class `.col-box-{color}` to apply colour box styling, e.g. `.col-box-Gold`

::: {columns}

Default height is 450px
:::

::: {.column .col-box-Green width="32%"}

:::

::: {.column .col-box-Blue width="32%"}

:::
:::

# Non-UoB-specific nice-to-haves {.Green-bg}

## Alignment

There are classes to help with text alignment:

:::{.center-h}
`{.center-h}` gives horizontally-centered text
:::

:::{.right}
`{.right}` gives right-aligned text
:::

:::{.callout-note}
For all revealjs Quarto presentations, applying `{.center}` to the slide title vertically centers the whole slide.
:::

## Sizing

There are classes to help size text by a given percentage:

[`{.smaller90}`]{.smaller90}, [`{.smaller80}`]{.smaller80}, [`{.smaller75}`]{.smaller75}
[`{.smaller70}`]{.smaller70}, [`{.smaller60}`]{.smaller60}, [`{.smaller50}`]{.smaller50}

[`{.larger125}`]{.larger125}, [`{.larger150}`]{.larger150}, [`{.larger175}`]{.larger175}, 
[`{.larger200}`]{.larger200}, [`{.larger250}`]{.larger250}
